description: Somos uma equipe em busca de novos conhecimentos e experiências, gostamos de nos desafiar e inovar. Estamos muito empolgados de participar do nosso primeiro Hackathon da NASA Space Apps Challenge.
summary: We decided this challenge because, our team think that is so important for saving money with some troubles in the base of moon.
details:
Shackleton Station is a training simulator for junior astronauts:

* The mission: the trainee runs a base at the Moon’s south pole for 6 days, with 4 crew members.

* NASA data: oxygen, water, food, energy and radiation follow real NASA rates (BVAD, the ISS

oxygen generator, the VSAT solar panels).

* Decisions: each run randomly picks one of two scenarios for each NASA theme (water, food,

energy, thermal control, life support, radiation) and shuffles their order and answer options, so the

trainee can’t memorize answers. A random micrometeoroid strike also tests communication and

navigation.

* Feedback: every choice shows right away whether it was correct, with a real NASA fact explaining

why.

* Energy management: day 6 has no sunlight, so the trainee must ration energy to keep life support

running.

* Score: at the end, the trainee gets a readiness score from 0 to 100 and a level from 1 to 5, used to

rank the best candidates for a lunar mission
